summary: The registrant Israel Acquisitions Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting a sixth amendment to its business combination agreement with Gadfin Ltd. Under the amendment, the termination date under Section 7.1(d) of the BCA is extended to June 15, 2026; all other termination rights remain unchanged. The filing constitutes a step in an ongoing de-SPAC transaction. The registrant is the SPAC vehicle acting as the target/acquiree. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The extension suggests the parties are working to close the merger by mid-June 2026. Risk-arb watchers should monitor shareholder approval and any further extensions.
